title: API: create with padded number and description returns 201 with trimmed values and linkedToExistingEntry false
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. QA-NEW-77 is neither stocked here nor in the Part Library (if a previous run left it, delete it first or add a suffix). Take <cat> and <defaultBin> ids from the requests the New Inventory Part dialog loads in the Network tab. No DB access: values the handoff checks in the DB are verified through the API response, the UI and Part History instead.
custom_steps:
1. Send POST /api/inventory/parts/create {"partNumber":" QA-NEW-77 ","description":" QA brake pad ","categoryId":"<cat>","vendorId":null,"manufacturerId":null,"quantity":0,"cost":"10.00","sellPrice":null,"min":0,"max":0,"gridLocation":null,"coreCharge":null,"environmentalCharge":null,"tags":["qa"],"bins":[{"id":"<defaultBin>","quantity":0,"isDefault":true}],"isFixedPrice":false}.
  2. Search QA-NEW-77 on /parts/inventory and open the part.
  3. Go to Parts → Part Library and search QA-NEW-77.
  4. Resend the step 1 request unchanged.
  5. Cleanup: open the new part and click Delete Part (button_delete_part).
custom_expected:
1. 201 with partNumber "QA-NEW-77", description "QA brake pad", linkedToExistingEntry: false and libraryDescriptionKept: false.
  2. One row; the dialog shows Part Number "QA-NEW-77" and Description "QA brake pad" with no leading or trailing spaces.
  3. Exactly one new entry QA-NEW-77 with description "QA brake pad".
  4. 400 "QA-NEW-77 already exists at this location."; no second part or entry is created.
  5. The part is deleted at once (no confirmation), the dialog closes and the list reloads without it.
